- This fork: dongliuwuzhong-arch/DSH-purge"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> 🔴 **Read this first: host patches need a precondition to take effect.**
>
> The official desktop b"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"uild seals its host code in `resources\app.asar`, while patches can only be
> written into the unpac"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ked `resources\app\`. Electron resolves in the order

>
> "Patches are applied" therefore d"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"oes not mean "patches are in effect". The only reliable check is
> whether the status panel still pr"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ints `✗ app.asar: still present` — that line means everything is idle.
>
> Since 1.2.1 the post-upgr"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"ade self-heal is automatic; see `docs/SEALED-ASAR.md`.
`dsh-purge` is a prompt and host-patch plugin"},{"id":"p5s8","text":" for a local DeepSeek Harness install. It adds a **Clean** dock beside the session title for managin"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"g prompts, rule sets, skills, and host patches. Nothing is written to the host until you explicitly "},{"id":"p5s10","text":", rule sets, skills, and host patches. Nothing is written to the host until you explicitly apply it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"This repository is a compatibility fork of the upstream project, tracking DSH **0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3 / "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"rc.5**. It currently has one page: **Clean**."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Area | What it does |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Patches | Grouped patch status, Apply, Restore, Uninstall |
| Prompt | Edit `prompt-inject.md` as "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"the session override |
| Rule sets | Manage `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` sets; enabling one writes unde"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"r the current `$DSH_HOME` |
| Skills | Import a zip or folder into this host's official `skills/<id>"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"/SKILL.md`; DSH owns matching and loading |
| Own servers | Register one IP or exact hostname per li"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ne in `net-scope-allow.txt` |

The host's prompt fil"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"e on disk is not read.
- `prompt-inject.md` is a user file. Revert and uninstall keep it by default."},{"id":"p13s3","text":"
- Rule sets can be switched; they are written under `$DSH_HOME/rules/`.
